g.text: LIVE VIDEO
consult + triage +
follow-up!
STORE-FORWARD
photos, ECGs, labs
sent for review!
mHEALTH
SMS, apps, hotlines,
wearables!
REMOTE MONITOR
BP cuffs, glucometers,
oximeters at home!
SAFETY FIRST
consent + privacy +
escalation plan!
4 MODES: synchronous video · store-and-forward · mHealth messaging/apps · remote
monitoring. Ghana wins: specialist consults to districts, ANC/CWC SMS reminders, chronic-
disease follow-ups without travel, outbreak hotlines, CHPS supervision at distance.
NURSE'S VIRTUAL TOOLKIT: confirm identity (2 identifiers on EVERY call!) + consent for
virtual care + private setting both ends + structured assessment (SBAR thinking!) + clear
escalation ("go to OPD NOW if...") + DOCUMENT like a ward visit (mode, consent, findings,
advice, follow-up!). A phone review is a CLINICAL ENCOUNTER — chart it fully (M02!).
mHEALTH RULES: verify numbers before sending (wrong-phone results = breach! — M03) · plain
language + local languages + teach-back · never diagnoses/results by bulk SMS · log every
message thread in the record. "Your labs are ready, please come" — not "your HIV result…".
REMOTE MONITORING: teach device + technique + logbook (NUT/GHTN BP diaries!) · set alert
thresholds · define response times · plan device/power failures. Data flows in — the NURSE
still triages it (M01 DIKW!).
EQUITY CHECK (M06!): no smartphone? no network? no literacy? — offer alternatives (voice
calls, CHPS visits, paper logs). Digital care must not abandon the disconnected.
LIMITS: no palpation, no smell, weak rapport — examine in person when unsure; emergencies
go to facilities, not video queues. Telehealth EXTENDS the nurse; never replaces her.
MANTRA: "identify, consent, assess, document, escalate — distance changes nothing."
